stem_book: State whether the following are true or false. (i) The addition of a catalyst to a system at equilibrium changes the equilibrium position. (ii) Decreasing the concentration of a product will shift the equilibrium to the right. (iii) Le Chatelier's principle can be applied to all types of reactions. (iv) A decrease in temperature will shift the equilibrium to the side of an endothermic reaction. (v) An increase in volume will shift the reaction towards the side with more gas molecules.
